title: Mechanisms of Antitumor Invasion and Metastasis of the Marine Fungal Derivative Epi-Aszonalenin A in HT1080 Cells.
authors: Liu, Yi; Lin, Liyuan; Zheng, Haiyan; He, Yuan-Lin; Li, Yanmei; Zhou, Chunxia; Hong, Pengzhi; Sun, Shengli; Zhang, Yi; Qian, Zhong-Ji
one_liner_zh: 该文研究海洋真菌衍生物EAA抑制肿瘤侵袭转移的机制，分子对接仅涉及小分子与MMP蛋白，无蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Epi-aszonalenin A (EAA) is an alkaloid that is isolated and purified from the secondary metabolites of coral symbiotic fungi and has been shown to have good atherosclerotic intervention activity and anti-angiogenic activity in our previous studies. In the present study, antiangiogenic activity was used as a basis of an intensive study of its mechanism of action against tumor metastasis and invasion. Invasive metastatic pairs are a hallmark of malignancy, and the dissemination of tumor cells is the most dangerous process in the development of tumors. The results of cell wound healing and the Transwell chamber assay showed that EAA interfered well with PMA-induced migration and invasion of HT1080 cells. Western blot and the ELISA assay showed that EAA decreased MMPs and vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) activity and inhibited the expression of N-cadherin and hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha) by regulating the phosphorylation of downstream mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK), PI3K/AKT, and NF-kappaB pathways. Simultaneous molecular docking results revealed that the mimic coupling between the EAA and MMP-2/-9 molecules formed a stable interaction. The results of this study provide a research basis for the inhibition of tumor metastasis by EAA, and together with previous studies, confirm the potential pharmacology and drug potential for this class of compound for application in angiogenesis-related diseases and further improve the availability of coral symbiotic fungi.
abstract_zh: Epi-aszonalenin A（EAA）是一种从珊瑚共生真菌次级代谢产物中分离纯化得到的生物碱，在我们先前的研究中已显示其具有良好的抗动脉粥样硬化干预活性和抗血管生成活性。本研究以抗血管生成活性为基础，深入研究其抗肿瘤转移和侵袭的作用机制。侵袭性转移对是恶性肿瘤的标志，而肿瘤细胞的播散是肿瘤发展过程中最危险的环节。细胞伤口愈合实验和Transwell小室实验结果表明，EAA能有效干扰PMA诱导的HT1080细胞迁移和侵袭。Western blot和ELISA实验显示，EAA通过调控下游丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）、PI3K/AKT和NF-kappaB通路的磷酸化，降低MMPs和血管内皮生长因子（VEGF）活性，并抑制N-cadherin和缺氧诱导因子-1alpha（HIF-1alpha）的表达。同时，分子对接结果揭示EAA与MMP-2/-9分子之间的模拟偶联形成了稳定相互作用。本研究结果为EAA抑制肿瘤转移提供了研究基础，并结合先前研究，确认了该类化合物在血管生成相关疾病应用中的潜在药理学和药物开发价值，进一步提高了珊瑚共生真菌的利用性。
